in_marathi.name: Kuntal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Coiled or twisted
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuntal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kuntala’, meaning ‘coiled or twisted’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is depicted with a snake coiled around his neck, symbolizing protection and power. Kuntal may symbolize strength, resilience, and adaptability.
